style.name: Cyberpunk
style.description: Cyberpunk imagery places advanced technology within gritty, socially fractured futures. Digital interfaces inspired by it often combine dark urban surfaces, sharp neon accents, industrial labels, and signs of technological interference.

fonts.heading: Space Grotesk
fonts.rationale: Bold geometric headings and technical monospaced details evoke industrial systems without resorting to unreadable novelty type.

tips: Use neon as a signal against quieter dark surfaces.
Make technical labels convey real content.
Keep glitch effects optional and brief.
avoid: Flashing effects or persistent visual interference.
Decorative warning states that look actionable.
Dense neon text without resting space.

recipe.composition: Use clipped corners, strong warning-like contrast, and technical alignment; retain an obvious reading path.
recipe.motion: Use immediate state feedback; avoid glitch loops, flashing text, and fake security alerts.
recipe.signature: Dystopian contrast, angular surfaces, and an intentionally charged technical atmosphere.
